plugins.name: local-ipc
plugins.description: Local inter-session IPC channel for Claude Code — lets two or more Claude Code sessions on the same machine exchange messages via a filesystem queue. Each session is identified by LOCAL_IPC_AGENT_NAME env var.

plugins.name: cete-tasks
plugins.description: Durable, completion-tracked task tools (assign_task / my_tasks / claim_task / complete_task / fail_task / cancel_task) for co-located Claude Code agents — a thin MCP client over cete-os-server's REST API. Drop-in replacement for local-ipc's pre-0.3.0 task primitive; agent identity reuses LOCAL_IPC_AGENT_NAME.
